db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file storing greylisting data.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for Exim to connect to greylistd (must match Exim config).

expire_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which a greylisted entry expires and is removed from the database (default: 3 days).

min_delay.description: Minimum delay (in seconds) greylistd tells Exim to wait before retry (RFC-compliant: ≥ 300 seconds).

max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) after which greylisting is no longer enforced (default: 12 hours).

initial_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) before first retry is allowed for brand-new greylisted entries (default: 5 minutes).

whitelist.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to exempt from greylisting (IPv4 and IPv6 supported).

whitelist_senders.description: List of sender addresses/domains to exempt from greylisting (exact email or domain with leading dot for subdomains).

items.description: Sender email or domain (e.g., 'noreply@example.com', '.google.com' for all subdomains).

whitelist_recipients.description: List of recipient addresses/domains to exempt from greylisting.

auto_whitelist_threshold.description: Number of successful (non-greylisted) deliveries after which an IP is auto-whitelisted (set to 0 to disable auto-whitelisting).

log_syslog.description: Enable logging to syslog (recommended for production).

user.description: User account under which greylistd drops privileges (must have access to Exim’s spool directory).

group.description: Group for privilege drop (typically matches the user).

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support in the database (required if your network uses IPv6).

per_recipient.description: Enable per-recipient greylisting — if disabled, greylisting is applied only per (IP, sender) pair.

socket_timeout.description: Socket read/write timeout (in seconds) when communicating with Exim.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for greylistd process tracking.
